action.sql: SELECT store_id, product_id IN ('x') AS dummy, count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date<'2024-03-01') AS n_before, avg(delay_days) FILTER (WHERE order_date<'2024-03-01') AS d_before, count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date>='2024-03-01') AS n_after, avg(delay_days) FILTER (WHERE order_date>='2024-03-01') AS d_after FROM purchase_order GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
